evidence.M3: model.py SAYS['not_issued'] and policy.md A3/A4 tell the customer 'the refund is not issued and not confirmed yet'. model.py refund_steps uses this message after a timed-out refund whose lookup shows failed or none, so it says the refund was not issued, which R-08's 'not confirmed yet' does not
evidence.P7: rules.md R-12/D-01 'The agent cancels one order per request. When the customer names a second order, that order gets its own proposal and its own yes'; table rows for two orders in one message and another order after the case is over
